_provenance.note: No live GitLab mirror is reachable from this environment (record-fixtures.mjs:27-34's standing constraint) — hand-authored from the documented GitLab REST API v4 issues shape (https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/issues.html), trimmed to the fields gitlab.mjs#issueList actually consumes (iid, title, labels). GitLab's issues endpoint returns only issues — no pull_request-equivalent field exists on any entry, which is itself why the pull_request filter is GitHub-only. labels is already a flat string array (no per-label object unwrapping needed), unlike GitHub's label objects. Two entries, matching the github-issueList-happy.json discipline of exercising the per-entry assertion loop genuinely.
